info.title: Compass AI Backend API
info.description: Document analysis with grounded, citation-backed answers, scoped to a client portal. Tenancy is derived from a verified portalFeatureContextToken sent as x-portal-context: NO operation accepts a client, workspace or portal identifier from the caller, and one that carries one is rejected with TENANCY_PROBE. Every operation enforces the derived actor (employee or client) inside its handler. All operations are private: there is no cross-app consumer.

Error.description: Every failure carries a stable machine code. For a portal failure the message is separately authored to be safe to show a client.

Citation.description: Resolved provenance for one key statement. Only passages that were actually retrieved can appear here; citations the model invents are stripped server-side.

IndexHealthDocument.description: Per-document pipeline health. chunksEmbedded > 0 is what makes a document searchable.

EmbeddingBatch.description: An OpenAI Batch API job embedding a bulk upload. Roughly half the synchronous price, with a completion window of up to 24 hours.

Actor.description: Derived per request from the portal context plus the org role. Never stored.

Capabilities.description: What the actor may do. Used by the SPA to decide what to RENDER; a false capability means the control is absent from the DOM, not disabled. Every one is re-checked server-side.

settings.description: Employees receive the full resolved settings with per-key provenance; clients receive only the values that shape their experience.

SourceConfig.description: Column mapping for a compasses_table source. Table and column names are validated as plain lowercase identifiers before they reach SQL, where identifiers cannot be parameterised.

file.description: Column holding a stored-file uuid or a readable URL.

fileUrl.description: Column holding a readable URL. Required when `file` holds a uuid: the file service issues a read URL once at upload and it bears no relation to the uuid, and Gate exposes no uuid-to-URL lookup, so without it the bytes are unreachable.

filter.description: Employee-authored SQL WHERE fragment, at the same trust level as the table name. Never built from end-user input.

PortalContext.name: x-portal-context
PortalContext.description: Platform-signed portalFeatureContextToken from the iframe URL. Verified through Gate on every request; a local decode is never trusted. It proves WHERE the request is from, never WHO — identity comes from the caller session.

TenancyProbe.description: The request carried a client/workspace/portal identifier. Refused rather than ignored.

PortalRejected.description: Portal context missing, unverifiable, unbound, paused, or the caller is not a member.

NotFound.description: Not found, or it belongs to another client. Deliberately indistinguishable.

get.summary: List the chats of this portal

post.description: The client comes from the portal context. An empty documentIds means every indexed document in scope.

get.summary: Read a chat transcript and its document scope
get.description: A chat of another client is a 404.

put.summary: Replace the document scope of a chat
put.description: Every id must belong to the client of this portal, so a citation can only ever name a document the caller may read.

post.description: Answers strictly from the retrieved passages, and returns the fixed no-information sentence when nothing relevant is retrieved. Refuses with 429 once the monthly token budget is reached, before any paid call.

get.summary: List the documents of this portal
get.description: Scoped by the verified portal. Clients see only indexed documents; employees also see processing and failed ones, because they are the people who fix them.

post.description: Employee-only. The client id comes from the portal context and never from the form; a tenant key in the form is a TENANCY_PROBE. Ingestion runs on the queue, so this returns 202.

get.description: A document of another client is a 404, never a 403.

delete.summary: Delete a document and its index entries
delete.description: Employee-only and irreversible: pages, paragraphs and passages cascade from the document row.

get.description: Proxied so the tenancy check applies to the bytes themselves. The file service read URL is public and is never handed to the browser.
Normalized top-left-origin bounding boxes, so a citation can highlight the exact region it came from.

post.summary: Re-run the pipeline from stored bytes

get.description: Both actors. `editable` states whether the caller may change the tree, so the UI does not infer it from the actor.

post.description: Employee-only. Five levels deep at most.

409.description: A folder of that name already exists here

put.summary: File a document into a folder
put.description: Employee-only. `folderId: null` moves it to Unfiled. Sets `folder_pinned`, so a source’s folder column stops re-filing it. Never re-indexes — a document’s location has nothing to do with its content.

patch.description: Employee-only. `parentId` is applied only when the key is present, so a rename does not silently move the folder to the root. A move that would create a cycle or exceed the depth limit is a 400 naming which.

delete.description: Employee-only. Documents and subfolders move up to the parent; no document is ever deleted.

get.description: Reports whether the backend can reach the isolated store, and whether OCR and OpenAI are configured. Operator diagnostic; also used by the e2e suite to self-skip specs whose dependency is unset.
Employee-only. One batched read, so the whole snapshot comes from a single transaction and cannot contradict itself.

post.description: Employee-only. Vectors already applied are kept.

get.description: Resolves the verified portal to exactly one client and derives the actor. Returns the capabilities the SPA renders from. Replaces the removed /workspaces routes: there is no client list and no client creation.
Employee-only. Precedence is portal override, then client settings, then defaults; each key reports which layer it came from.

patch.description: Employee-only. Writes the client layer rather than the portal override, which would silently shadow it.

get.summary: Sources bound to this portal, and the client’s available ones
get.description: Employee-only. Returns both lists in one call because the admin screen shows what the portal is bound to alongside what it could be bound to.

post.description: Employee-only. The config is validated before the row is written, so an unusable mapping fails in the form rather than as a failed sync run later.

post.summary: Resolve a source config without saving it
post.description: Employee-only. Returns the row count and a capped sample so a mis-mapped column is visible as a list of names rather than hidden in a JSON blob.

patch.summary: Rename a source, retime it, or replace its config
patch.description: Employee-only. `syncEnabled` governs scheduling only — "Sync now" still runs on a paused source.

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Source id. Must belong to this portal’s client.

post.summary: Bind a source to this portal

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Source id. Must belong to this portal’s client.

delete.summary: Unbind a source from this portal
delete.description: Employee-only. Never deletes documents: rows whose last binding is removed become orphaned — hidden from clients, still visible to employees.

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Source id. Must belong to this portal’s client.

post.summary: Queue a sync for this source
post.description: Employee-only. Enqueued rather than run inline: a first sync of a large table parses and embeds every document, which is minutes of work against a 30s request ceiling.

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Source id. Must belong to this portal’s client.

post.description: Safety net for jobs left behind when a replica is recycled mid-run. Idempotent. Under /api/webhooks/ so a scheduled caller reaches it without an app token; the path segment is unguessable.
